title: entaticus albidus
intro: Entaticus albidus, commonly known as White Stinging Nettle, is a flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of allergies, due to its anti-inflammatory and antihistamine properties. The therapeutic actions of Entaticus albidus include its ability to soothe and calm irritated skin, as well as its potential to aid in digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Entaticus albidus include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
